info.name: DA Registry API (dev edition, 27 Oct 2026)
info.description:
Staff API of the DA Registry as deployed on dev (https://staff-da-registry.development.oanstaging.com) on 27 Oct 2026. Use with environment da-registry-dev.postman_environment.json: fill `password`, run folder 0. Login (0-dev-a, b, c), then the requests. Token lives 5 minutes.

Dev behaviour today: approval has ONE stage (request 10 / 16 completes it); DAs from Excel import (S18/S19) and ingest (S16) are approved automatically and get a DA-ID without a task; a DA's own login is not yet limited to their own record. Two-level approval, manual approval of imports and the DA own-record rule are built and tested locally and will reach dev with the platform refactor; the endpoints will not change.

Not on dev: S16 answers REGP-ERR-001 PARTNER_NOT_REGISTERED (partner registration pending with DevOps); the Partner API / DCI folder is on hold for phase 1.

item.name: 0. Login
item.description: Dev: send 0-dev-a, 0-dev-b, 0-dev-c in order (browser-style sign-in through Keycloak + IAM); the scripts save token and csrf. The token lives 5 minutes: re-run the three when a call answers G2P-AUT-401. Needs username/password in the environment.

request.description: Follows the redirect to Keycloak and keeps the login page. The test script saves the form action into `kc_login_action`. Postman stores the Keycloak session cookies automatically.

exec: if (!m) { throw new Error("Login form not found. Is staff_portal_ui correct? " + pm.environment.get("staff_portal_ui")); }
console.log("Login form action saved. Now send 0-dev-b.");

request.description: Posts the credentials to Keycloak. Redirects are OFF on purpose: the 302 Location (IAM callback) is saved into `iam_callback`.

exec: throw new Error("Login failed (" + pm.response.code + "): " + err.trim() + ". Check username/password in the environment, and re-run 0-dev-a (the login page expires).");
pm.test("Credentials accepted (302 to IAM callback)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(302));
console.log("Redirected to IAM callback. Now send 0-dev-c.");

request.description: Calls the IAM callback with redirects OFF; its Set-Cookie headers carry X-Access-Token and X-CSRF-Token, which the test script copies into `token` and `csrf`.

exec: pm.test("IAM callback set the session cookies", () => pm.expect([302, 307]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: Approval

request.description: Approve or reject the task. Dev today: this single decision completes the approval; the DA is written to the register and gets its DA-ID within ~15 s (request 11).

Wait 15-30 s after the approval; the DA-ID may show as TEMP-… for a few seconds.

Note: approval is processed in the background. Wait about 10 seconds after request 10 (or 16) before sending this one, otherwise you get REGISTER_DATA_NOT_FOUND. The DA-ID appears in `functional_record_id` once assigned.

item.description: Dev today: one approval stage. Order: 7 -> 9 -> 10, wait ~10 s, 11 for the DA-ID. Approvers: Operations Administrator, Intake Validator (intake) / Data Validator (change request). Two-level approval comes later with the refactor (same APIs, a second task with current_stage 2).

item.name: Staff API: bulk import (ingest one DA, or upload a file)
S16. Register a DA through the staff API (ingest-data, same body as 17)

request.description: The staff API's version of the partner push (17): same raw body (header + message), but with the signed-in user's token and CSRF instead of a partner signature. Permission intakeSubmission:edit (role Intake Officer). Response: response_payload.correlation_id. The DA is validated and on dev approved automatically; the DA-ID appears in 20-60 s (S17 for the outcome). This is the phase-1 path for DA Services bulk import: one request per DA. On dev this answers REGP-ERR-001 PARTNER_NOT_REGISTERED until DA Services (header.sender_id da-services) is registered in Partner Management by DevOps; the form path (Single DA form folder) works on dev without it.

item.name: S17. Outcome of an ingest (search_in_ingestion_data by reference_id)

request.description: Platform view of an ingest: search_text matches anywhere in the raw payload, so the reference_id finds it. Returns the pipeline state (classification_status PROCESSED / FAILED, classification_latest_error_code, intake_form_submission_id, ingest_correlation_id), not the DA-ID. Permission incomingMessage:view (role Integration Manager). For DA-ID and a plain reason use 18 (/partner/da/status) on the partner API, or S13 with the submission's record.

item.description: Bulk import through the staff API. Dev today: imported DAs are approved automatically (no task) and get their DA-ID in 1-2 minutes; a row with an unknown Kebele or a duplicate Fayda ID is rejected with the reason (S17). S16 (one DA per request) needs the partner registration on dev (pending); use S18 + S19 (file upload) for bulk.

item.name: 17. Push a DA (bulk import, one per request)

request.description: Change fayda_id and reference_id for each push.

query.description: DUPLICATE_IDENTITY | INVALID_KEBELE | MISSING_MANDATORY_FIELD | INVALID_FIELD | REJECTED | FAILED_SYNC

request.description: Every DA that is stuck (DA Services pushes and file-import rows), with reason and exception_type. Only the latest attempt per record. correlation_id works with 18.
Also zone_code (e.g. ET0403). Codes are Master Data P-codes; always filter by code, names repeat.
DAs registered or changed (approved) after the given time. Use for incremental sync: run with the time of the last run.

Several filters in one query are combined with AND. This is the DARegistryClient.get_da_list() mapping: woreda->woreda_code, kebele->geo_lowest_level_value_id, education_tier->education_level, active_status->record_status, search->search_text. An empty query is rejected: send record_status ACTIVE to list all.

item.name: 24. Code list values (dropdowns: specialisation, position, qualification, prefix, gender, marital status, source)

request.description: Every DA dropdown reads its values from Master Data (the openg2p-data pack ETH-OAN). Same token as the staff API. attribute_id: DA_SPECIALISATION, DA_POSITION, DA_EDUCATION_LEVEL (qualification), DA_SOURCE, PREFIX, GENDER, MARITAL_STATUS. Save value_id on the DA (education_level, specialisation, position, prefix, gender, marital_status); show value_display. Do not hardcode the lists.
